title: Class II device recall: VITEK 2 AST-N461 TEST KIT, GRAM NEGATIVE SUSCEPTIBILITY TESTING -
summary: The issue is related to card pouch damage associated with a portion of the lot which was produced on a specific card pouching device, in a specific timeframe, causing a potential risk of false resistant results. False resistant results may lead to the use of less effective antibiotic treatments or the association of multiple antibiotics having negative side effects, which could potentially impact
place: International distribution to the countries of Austria, Germany, Luxembourg.
